scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @telecus/backend && npm run build --workspace @telecus/frontend
scripts.release: npm run check:layout && npm run check && node scripts/package-release.cjs
scripts.prepare:share: npm run check:layout && npm run check:architecture && npm run check && node scripts/package-release.cjs --folder
scripts.test:security: npm run build --workspace @telecus/backend && node --test --test-isolation=none tests/security-boundaries.test.cjs tests/origin-policy.test.cjs tests/http-modules.test.cjs tests/payment-http.test.cjs tests/clinical-documents.test.cjs tests/release-policy.test.cjs
